A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TInR research work, with complete, readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C. Matching content across page breaks establishes that no research material is missing.

before.justification: v1 reports original TInR-U experiments on ToolACE, xLAM, and BFCL, including benchmark results, ablations, efficiency measurements, and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experiments and results from v1, including Tables 2–12 and the analyses in Appendix B.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.6 retain identical tool tokenization, bidirectional knowledge alignment, SFT warm-up, GRPO training, rewards, and two-step tool calling.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same datasets and scenarios, including ToolACE/xLAM in-domain evaluation, BFCL out-of-domain evaluation, multi-turn tasks, continual learning, and tool updates.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main and appendix experiments. The retrieval pipelines, ToolGen, ATU, DeepAgent, and other evaluated baselines are retained in their corresponding comparisons.

E3.justification: Dataset splits and counts, evaluation metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and testing procedures are identical, including the hardware and larger-model experiments in Appendix B.3.

E4.justification: The component ablations, backbone and indexing analyses, continual-learning and tool-update tests, case study, and appendix recall, efficiency, and hyperparameter analyses are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix A retains the statement that training was repeated 'several times' and the 'mid one' reported. Neither version specifies an exact run count or adds seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including appendix results. For example, Table 3 retains tool-calling EM scores of 26.00 for TInR-U and 22.01 for ToolGen in both versions.

T1.justification: The task formulation and Equations (1)–(11) are identical. Appendix B.5 is also unchanged, with no added or revised formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain identical claims about tool-internalized reasoning, the three-phase framework, effectiveness, efficiency, and generalization.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same mechanism explanations and qualifications, including the two-step design, adaptation and maintenance costs, dataset coverage limitations, and potentially false-negative tool labels.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware information, data-construction procedures, Appendix C prompts, and the code-access statement are unchanged. The new funding acknowledgment adds no reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions, research positioning, and the complete reference list are identical. References that cross different page boundaries in v2 are retained, not added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short Acknowledgments section before References, identifying funding sources and grants, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The research prose and narrative structure otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgments cause limited reference and appendix text reflow on pages 10–14; Appendix B.3 now begins on page 13 instead of page 12. Figures and tables retain their content, design, and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding attribution and incidental text reflow, while preserving all scientific content, evidence, explanations, and reproducibility details, including the appendices. These limited editorial changes do not materially improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
